versions.content: Upstream requirements: SRS_Rte_00189 If the RTE Generator is configured to support the ( DOUBLE_POINTERED ) method the RTE Generator in generation phase shall generate a VariableDataPrototype with the role staticMemory in the InternalBehavior of the RTE’s Basic Software Module Description.
